title: Both must be true
prompt: Someone can enter the concert only if they are at least 18 AND they have a ticket. Return true if they can enter.
signature: func solve(age: int, has_ticket: bool) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(age: int, has_ticket: bool) -> bool:
	return has_ticket
hint: has_ticket is already true or false; you can put it straight into an and.
solution:
func solve(age: int, has_ticket: bool) -> bool:
	return age >= 18 and has_ticket
